name: restore_edge_config_backup
description:
Restore a Global Config (Edge Config) from a backup version, identified by Global Config ID and backup version ID. The backup's contents become the Global Config's current data.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/global-config/{edgeConfigId}/backups/{edgeConfigBackupVersionId}/restore --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
